purpose: Frozen D = M ∪ P ∪ O decomposition per INSA v0.3 §12 + proposal v5.1. Pairwise-disjointness verified. O = ∅ with frozen rationale.
D_definition: D := M ∪ P ∪ O (disjoint union); D is the complete set of scored behavioral dimensions.

dimensions.label: near_date_historical_event_addition
dimensions.additive_verification: Verified additive: does not remove, replace, or alter any existing behavior in the frozen BIB behavioral contract. Adds a single new event-connection to the output.
dimensions.bounded_verification: Single-target: exactly one such event per output (not zero, not two-or-more). The 'exactly one' constraint is the bounded-ness check.
dimensions.distinction_requirement: The near-date event must be clearly distinguished from exact-date connections (i.e., the report must label the distinction; it must not be presented as an exact-date connection).
dimensions.scope_bound: Within +/-30 calendar days of the birth date; not globally historical.

P.label: required preservation dimensions
P.subset_a_role: calibrated BIB 4-dim behavior vector (primary identity metric); actual BIB dim names verified from experiments/2026-09-05-dbi-bib-001-rerun-001/evaluation/evaluator-{A,B}-scores-LOCKED.jsonl
P.subset_b_role: 8 C12 non-target preservation axes preserved verbatim from v0.1 §11.3; the v0.1 axis labels do not exactly map to the BIB 4-dim names per subset-(a); the binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes (failure = score == 0) is an INSA-ID-E1 preregistered rule, NOT an inherited v0.1 rule

O.label: out-of-scope dimensions
O.rationale: The BIB 4-dim vector + 8 C12 axes exhaust the scored dimensions tracked by the frozen evaluator rubric. No additional dimensions are scored in this experiment. Any candidate output dimension not in D = M ∪ P is unscored and therefore not a basis for any gate.

pairwise_disjoint_verification.method: set intersection assertion in Python; intersection of M ids, subset-(a) ids, subset-(b) ids, O ids must equal empty set
pairwise_disjoint_verification.verification_command: python3 -c "import json; a=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/mutation-dimensions.json'))['M_enumeration']); b=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-a.json'))['dimensions']); c=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json'))['axes']); assert a & b == set(), f'M ∩ subset-(a) = {a & b}'; assert a & c == set(), f'M ∩ subset-(b) = {a & c}'; assert b & c == set(), f'subset-(a) ∩ subset-(b) = {b & c}'; print('PASS: D = M ∪ P ∪ O is pairwise disjoint across all three subsets')
pairwise_disjoint_verification.actual: intersections: M∩sub_a=set(), M∩sub_b=set(), sub_a∩sub_b=set(); D = M ∪ P ∪ O is pairwise disjoint: True
